_about: Claude's blind UMBRELA grades for the 100 calibration pairs, authored from data/review/blind_worksheet.json (built from a pack that provably carried no judge grades: see scripts/blind_worksheet.py). Entries are in worksheet queue order; `item` and `sid` are checked against that order when the baseline is assembled, so a re-drawn sample cannot silently re-label anything.
_rubric: 3 the passage is about the question and states the answer; 2 it states the answer among other material or indirectly; 1 it is on the question's subject matter but does not answer; 0 it does not help at all. A shared name with no shared subject matter is 0, not 1: being by the right speaker is not being about the right thing.
_fields: n ordinal, item gold id, sid first 8 characters of the speech id, grade 0-3, summary what the passage says in plain English, why one sentence for the grade, marks verbatim spans to highlight (resolved to offsets when the pack is built), mark_kind answer|near_miss|none
